External Resources

Reference material from established security bodies. Useful when you want more depth than a summary page.

NCSC

UK NCSC — Small Business Guide

Short, practical guidance written for organisations without security staff. Applies well outside the UK.

Visit site (opens in a new tab)CISA

CISA — Cybersecurity for Small Business

US government resources, including free tools and plain-language explainers.

Visit site (opens in a new tab)NIST

NIST Small Business Cybersecurity Corner

Reference material and planning guides from the US standards body.

Visit site (opens in a new tab)APWG

Anti-Phishing Working Group

Reports and reference material on phishing trends, plus an address for reporting phishing messages.

Visit site (opens in a new tab)NPR

No More Ransom

A joint law-enforcement project offering free decryption tools for some ransomware families.
